text:
sam_sales: FYI Acme POC is blocked — they can't finish SSO + SCIM setup. Priya says Okta shows provisioning errors.
lucy_se: Thanks — can you paste the error screen or logs? quick note: we gave them Dedicated pool + hosted API keys for backend service.
priya_acme_admin: Error in Okta: 'Provisioning failed: 403 Forbidden: invalid_token'. Also SAML login fails for some users with 'Certificate mismatch'.
lucy_se: Ok. Two parallel things: 1) SCIM 403 likely token/scopes or IP allowlist. 2) SAML cert mismatch — probably metadata uploaded wrong or cert rotated.
priya_acme_admin: We uploaded the metadata from the console. ACS URL: https://acme.redwood-poc.example/saml/acs EntityID: https://redwood-inference/poc/acme
lucy_se: Can you confirm the x509 cert in Okta matches the metadata export? quick way: download metadata XML and check <ds:X509Certificate> value.
priya_acme_admin: I downloaded and Okta shows a different fingerprint than the XML. We might have grabbed the default prod metadata earlier.
sam_sales: If it's cert mismatch we can regenerate metadata for the POC instance. Lucy — can infra reissue metadata for that tenant?
mike_sso: I'll reissue a fresh metadata bundle for tenant acme-poc now, rotating the SAML cert. New metadata will have ACS https://acme.poc.inference.redwood/saml/acs and entityID urn:redwood:acme:poc.
onboard-bot: Ticket #POC-1891 created: reissue SAML metadata for acme-poc, assigned to mike_sso. ETA 30m.
lucy_se: After Mike posts metadata, Priya please replace the cert in Okta and test login. For SCIM: Priya, can you paste the provisioning request example from Okta logs (headers + response)?
priya_acme_admin: Okta logs show POST /scim/v2/Users -> 403. Response: {"detail":"invalid_token"} Headers: Authorization: Bearer xxx..
lucy_se: Two likely causes: 1) wrong SCIM token (we rotate tokens per POC), 2) token lacking scim:write scope, 3) IP allowlist on their Dedicated pool blocking Okta IPs. Which applies?
priya_acme_admin: We copied token from an earlier email — maybe outdated. Also our security team requires outbound IP fixed list, I gave them the list from docs but they said requests still show 403.
mike_sso: I'll check server auth logs. If token mismatched we'll return 401/403 with reason 'invalid_token' in logs. If IP block, request will hit nginx before auth and show 403 from firewall. Give me a sample request_id from Okta logs.
priya_acme_admin: request_id=8d6f9b2a.
mike_sso: Found the request in logs: 2025-05-06T14:23:11Z request_id=8d6f9b2a src=34.201.12.9 action=auth status=403 reason=invalid_token token_id=tok-POC-202410-old
mike_sso: Token is expired/rotated. Okta is still sending an old token. Also noticed src IP 34.201.12.9 is NOT in our IP allowlist for the Dedicated pool — but the request failed before IP check due to token.
lucy_se: Action items: Mike will issue a fresh SCIM token for acme-poc, add a note on token rotation TTL and token_id, and verify IP allowlist includes Okta outbound IP ranges. Priya will update Okta app to use the new token and replace SAML cert after Mike posts metadata. Sam will confirm with Acme security.
sam_sales: Priya — do you need us to re-run a provisioning push from Redwood side after token update?
priya_acme_admin: Yes please, a test push would help.
mike_sso: Generated token tok-POC-2025-05-06 and posted it to Acme via secure channel. Also updated doc: SCIM token TTL = 30 days for POCs. Added Okta outbound CIDR list to the Dedicated allowlist for acme-poc.
onboard-bot: POC-1891 status -> in_progress (mike_sso).
lucy_se: Priya, try one user push and paste the Okta log snippet.
priya_acme_admin: Push succeeded! Okta shows 200 for POST /scim/v2/Users and user created. SAML SSO also works after cert swap. 
sam_sales: Awesome. We'll keep an eye on token expiry. Priya, any other blockers from security questionnaire?
priya_acme_admin: One more: audit logs retention question — will follow up in separate thread. Thanks all. :tada:
